projects.title: DJ URYA Booking Website
projects.name: Dj URYA
projects.desc: This project consists of developing and updating the showcase and commercial website dj-urya.fr to allow clients to directly book musical performances online. It integrates a synchronized availability calendar with automated email confirmation via Resend, as well as a secure admin space and a custom CMS for dynamic content and database management.
features: Secure admin area and custom CMS
projects.role: Design, full-stack development and production release
projects.context: DJ URYA handled bookings through private messages, with no visibility on availability and no record of past requests. The site replaces that manual back-and-forth with a complete booking flow: clients pick an open date, describe the event and get an automatic confirmation, while the artist manages the calendar and site content from a dedicated back-office.
challenges: Preventing double bookings on the same date through server-side locking at validation time, not just UI checks
Making transactional e-mail reliable (retry queue and logging of Resend failures)
Designing a CMS flexible enough to edit copy, pricing and galleries without redeploying
Keeping Lighthouse scores high despite heavy media: responsive images and deferred loading

projects.title: Multiplayer Strategic Board Game
projects.name: Conquete
projects.desc: Creation of a strategic board game in Java, featuring a bot for local multiplayer games, save management, and the generation of statistical match charts.
projects.role: Game engine and AI development, in a pair
projects.context: Turn-based board game inspired by territory conquest classics. The teaching goal was a testable architecture: the rules engine is fully decoupled from the Swing interface, so a whole game can be replayed in tests without opening a single window.
challenges: Strictly separating rules engine from interface so games stay replayable in tests
Designing a readable AI: weighted territory scoring rather than a costly search tree
Serialising a full game (board, players, history) in a format readable across versions
Computing end-of-game statistics without freezing the interface

projects.title: Air Traffic Simulator
projects.name: Aerien
projects.desc: This software engineering project is a real-time air traffic simulator designed to automatically model and manage aircraft movements and airport operations. It simulates complex scenarios including multiple flights, real-time flight paths, collision risk management, and unexpected events such as aviation emergencies.
features: Flight path and airport operations modeling
Aviation emergency and unexpected event handling
projects.role: Software architecture and real-time simulation, team of four
projects.context: Air traffic control simulator: dozens of aircraft follow flight plans, enter and leave the monitored airspace, and raise alerts when two trajectories converge. The radar renders the current state while the simulation advances at its own pace.
challenges: Running the simulation loop and radar rendering together without blocking or flicker
Detecting trajectory conflicts early enough to leave room to react
Injecting unplanned events (emergency, diversion, weather) without corrupting simulation state
Keeping the simulation deterministic so a scenario can be replayed identically

projects.title: Student Attendance Tracking System
projects.name: Presence
projects.desc: This project aims to design an automated attendance verification and management system using NFC smart cards for students or employees. It connects a Python hardware client reading badges via an ACR122U reader, a secure Spring Boot backend server validating schedules and preventing duplicates, and an admin web interface to manage history and attendance data.
features: Automated attendance tracking via NFC smart cards
Python hardware client for badge scanning
Secure Spring Boot backend preventing duplicate entries
Web admin interface for history and logs management
projects.role: Spring Boot backend, Python NFC client and admin interface
projects.context: End-to-end attendance tracking: an NFC reader in the room scans badges, a server validates each check-in against the timetable, and a web interface lets staff correct, export and audit the history.
challenges: Ignoring repeated reads of the same badge without dropping a legitimate check-in
Securing the pairing between physical reader and server (device token, no user account)
Staying usable during network outages: local queue then synchronisation
Making the setup reproducible through Docker for classroom demos

projects.title: Educational Application for Students
projects.name: learnpy
projects.desc: Development of an interactive Python application to teach programming to students. The application includes a custom code editor, real-time feedback generation, and student statistics storage.
projects.context: A hands-on platform for learning Python: every concept comes with automatically graded exercises that explain what went wrong instead of returning a bare pass/fail.
challenges: Running user code without exposing the host machine (sandbox and time limits)
Turning raw Python errors into messages a beginner can act on
Tracking progress and suggesting the next exercise based on concepts already mastered
Keeping the editor responsive on modest hardware

projects.title: Online Tournament Generator
projects.name: Tournois
projects.desc: This project consists of developing a full-stack instant tournament management application capable of modeling competitions. It combines a React frontend in JavaScript for real-time score display and bracket generation with a secure REST API under Node.js/Express that handles user authentication, the favorites system, and data modification permissions.
features: Automatic and dynamic tournament bracket generation
Secure REST API with authentication and role-based permissions
projects.context: Tournament management tool: team registration, automatic bracket generation, score entry and a live standing shared by players and organisers alike.
challenges: Generating a balanced bracket for any team count, including non powers of two
Propagating a corrected score through the bracket without recomputing the whole tournament
Broadcasting the live standing to several screens at once
Handling edge cases: forfeit, draw, mid-tournament disqualification
